intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent arm of a five-way visual-semantics render test by inventing a distinct random complex photorealistic concept, using the supplied portrait only as appearance guidance, and preserving a scene suitable for later checking whether a selected visual keyword is visibly realized; this arm uses nocturnal desert radio-telescope calibration.

A complex, photorealistic nighttime environmental portrait at a remote high-altitude desert radio observatory. One unmistakably adult East Asian woman, visually informed by the supplied reference, has a refined oval face, warm ivory complexion, almond-shaped brown eyes, straight brows, a delicate nose, and softly defined lips. Her face is unobscured, and the complete arrangement of her hair is fully readable from crown to ends. She calibrates the array by turning the vernier on a tripod-mounted phase beacon while five diagnostic traces converge on a rugged field monitor; behind her, multiple radio dishes slew together toward a calibrator quasar above wind-rippled salt flats. Prioritize credible instrument interaction and fine mechanical detail, then clear facial likeness and complete hair readability. Preserve tactile desert dust, tiny status LEDs, distant service lights, layered depth, and physically convincing nocturnal atmosphere.
